notes: Starting cards as marked '(s)': Tatooine: Desert Heart, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Prepared Defenses, Well Guarded, No Bargain, Power Of The Hutt and Oppressive Enforcement, with the Objective; several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty.

The post lists 59 cards; the author's 'Cardlist edit' says 'Den Of Thieves should be the 14th effect', so Den Of Thieves is added (total 60). His suggestion to swap one card for a Resistance before a major tournament ('your choice') is not applied.

Posted 'Mara Jade (So I have 1 imperial sue me)' dested Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'EPP Fett' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'EJP Dengar' Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'ECC Iggy' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'ECC 4-LOM' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Mara's Saber' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Hell 2 Pay' There'll Be Hell To Pay; 'Tatooine Jundlund Wastes' Tatooine: Jundland Wastes.
Secret Plans and Oppressive Enforcement are the Special Edition Effects (Defensive Shields did not exist in 2000).
player_note: The description says: 'This is the biggest reason I won the B'Ham GS. This deck went 3-0 with insane differential. It won its games by 19, 17 and I'm proud to say that it beat Steven Lewis by 27.' (posted 29 October 2000). The strategy adds that it also beat Joe Horbey and Scott Lingrell at the DecipherCon team event and is 5-0 in tournament games.
